headline: Public hearings on requests to amend approval conditions for 36 and 44 Pillsbury Road, allowing some certificates of occupancy before off-site work is finished.
summary: The applicant, Procopio Enterprises, Inc., asks to change conditions for two Pillsbury Road properties owned by Pillsbury Realty Development, LLC. The changes would allow a limited number of certificates of occupancy before off-site improvements are complete, under an agreement with town staff.
items: Public hearing on request to amend conditions of approval for 36 Pillsbury Road
Public hearing on request to amend conditions of approval for 44 Pillsbury Road

Public hearing of an application for an amendment to the conditions of the 
approval granted by the Planning Board on April 8, 2026, which only allows for 
the issuance of certificates of occupancy after all off-site improvements are 
complete. An Off-Site Improvement agreement between town staff and the 
applicant agreed to the terms and conditions which included a provision for the 
issuance of a limited number of certificates of occupancy to be granted before 
completion. 36 Pillsbury Road , zoned Woodmont Commons (PUD) and 
Agricultural Residential - 1 (AR-1). Pillsbury Realty Development, LLC owner 
and Procopio Enterprises, Inc (applicant).
